subject: FinTechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.j@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinTechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up

Hi Alice / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the thorough discussion on FinTechCorp's production and regulatory requirements. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2: You asked whether Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant today. Short answer: Redwood is currently in the final audit run and expects a SOC 2 Type II report covering the core inference platform (controls for logical access, change management, incident response) by end of Q2. I'll attach the SOC 2 summary and a cover note for your security team.

- GDPR / HIPAA: We support data processing agreements and can provide contractual clauses for data subject rights and PHI handling. For HIPAA, we sign BAAs for covered use cases; we discussed the data flows and recommended scope for the BAA.

- Vendor questionnaire: You flagged a standard vendor security questionnaire — we can kick off the questionnaire via our security portal or share a spreadsheet if you prefer. Either way, Marissa (copied) will be the primary point for technical evidence.

- Incident response & breach notification: We confirmed Redwood follows a documented incident response process. Our usual notification SLA for confirmed incidents impacting customer data/availability is initial notification within 72 hours, with updates at agreed intervals and a post-incident report. Marissa will send the IR plan and BCP/DR evidence checklist.

Next steps / owners: 
1) Jordan: Share SOC2-summary.pdf and incident response checklist (attached) — by EOD tomorrow.
2) Marissa: Provide the incident response plan and sample post-incident report; start the questionnaire intake.
3) Alice / Tom: Confirm whether you want us to fill your vendor questionnaire directly or if you'll upload it to our portal.

If helpful, we can schedule a follow-up 30-min session for your security/tech ops next week to walk through controls and evidence.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

[attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf, 1.2 MB)]

From: Alice Johnson <alice.j@fintechcorp.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the clear recap — that helps. A couple of clarifying items from our side before we proceed to the questionnaire: 

1) SOC 2 timing: Q2 is fine but can you be more specific on the expected month and whether the coverage will include the control environment for logging and retention?
2) Incident notification: 72 hours initial notification is acceptable, but our legal team requires confirmation of the maximum time to provide a full post-incident report (e.g., 30 days) and whether you offer a template for the post-incident report.
3) BAA: We likely need HIPAA coverage for a specific pilot. Can you confirm who signs the BAA and typical turnaround time?

For the vendor questionnaire, we'll upload the spreadsheet to your portal — please send intake instructions or a portal link and we'll add our procurement contact.

Can Marissa / your security team include a redline-friendly sample of the incident response report and a quick list of what evidentiary artifacts you can provide (logs, retention policies, DR test dates, SOC 2 scope doc)?

Appreciate it — looking to close our evaluation in the next 3–4 weeks.

Best,
Alice Johnson
Head of Security Operations, FinTechCorp
alice.j@fintechcorp.com

Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.j@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up

Hi Alice / team,

Thanks — covering answers below and attaching the artifacts you requested.

1) SOC 2: Our audit firm has scheduled the Type II testing window for March 2026 with reporting expected in late April 2026. The SOC 2 scope includes infrastructure, logical access, logging/monitoring, incident management, and vendor management. The attached SOC2-summary.pdf highlights which systems and controls are covered.

2) Incident reports / timeline: For confirmed incidents impacting customer data or availability we provide:
   - Initial notification: within 72 hours of confirmation.
   - Interim updates: as we have material updates (typical cadence 24–72 hours).
   - Post-incident report: targeted delivery within 30 calendar days of incident closure. If additional forensic work is required, we commit to an interim technical summary at 30 days and a final report within 60 days.

3) Evidence artifacts we can provide (samples or redacted exports):
   - Incident response plan (attached: incident_response_plan.pdf)
   - Sample post-incident report (redacted)
   - Retention / logging policy excerpts and sample log extracts
   - Recent DR test date and summary (MM/DD/2025)
   - SOC 2 scope document (included in SOC2-summary.pdf)

4) BAA: Redwood executes BAAs for HIPAA-covered use cases. The typical turnaround time from first draft to signature is 7–14 business days depending on legal review cycles. Please send your procurement contact and redlines; Rachel can coordinate.

Portal intake: Jordan / Rachel — we can accept the vendor questionnaire via our security portal (https://redwood.app/s/FTC-4821/compliance-pack). Alice / Tom, please upload the spreadsheet; if you prefer, attach it to email and we can ingest and respond in the spreadsheet.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf, incident_response_plan.pdf, bcp_evidence_checklist.xlsx

Let me know if you want a 30-minute walkthrough next week — happy to present and answer questions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
